Parameter Name
WdgMExpiredSupervisionCycleTol
Parent Container
WdgMMode
Description
This parameter shall be used to define a value that fixes the amount of expired
supervision cycles for how long the blocking of watchdog triggering shall be postponed,
AFTER THE GLOBAL SUPERVISION STATUS HAS REACHED THE STATE
EXPIRED.
Multiplicity
